text: Hi everyone, we have a dilemma. I need to travel to Colombia. We had an appointment at the MH last Wednesday to upgrade from a B1 visa to an A5 visa. At the end of the interview, they told us we'll have to wait a maximum of three months for a response regarding the A5 visa approval. They extended my B1 visa for another three months, and I applied for an inter-visa because I need to leave. However, during those three months, they might call me while I'm not in the country, and I'd have to return earlier than planned. Has anyone been in this situation? Do you know how long this response might take? I'm undecided about whether to travel now or wait a little longer.
